parts.text: What worries me is when closures come into force while our drones are already in the air, or when closures are amended during the day. Radio coverage is patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, and reports from drones can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Drones sometimes even restart in flight after a software fault and carry on, while batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned.
